issue.title: [HFO-16] Add task help, local duty split and replacement-person handover
issue.description:
The system should make a new administrator effective without adding steps for experienced staff.

**Scope**
Attach concise versioned how-to/examples/contact to activities, expose current local owner/backup, and show open responsibilities on handover. Do not add mandatory training dialogs to every completion.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Experienced user completes without opening help; new user can find procedure/contact from the task.
- [ ] Duty changes retain prior ownership and accepted coverage with effective times.
- [ ] Procedure publication preserves historical rule references and sensitive documents stay protected.

**Dependencies:** [COL-135](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-135/hfo-02-version-facility-applicability-evidence-rules-and-local), [COL-148](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-148/hfo-10-build-the-staff-today-upcoming-and-history-workspace), [COL-144](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-144/hfo-14-track-problems-next-actions-backup-ownership-and-resolution)
**Related existing work:** See source pointers below
**Release:** Core. Implementation not started; this issue is not proof of deployment or staff acceptance.
**Source items:** Shared core contract across all applicable Admin Log items
**Source/code pointers:** `R02 R03, INT-17 INT-25`. Migration filenames are under `supabase/migrations/`; source paths are relative to Circle-of-Life unless explicitly named otherwise. Reconcile current main before editing.
**Open configuration questions:** Q02, Q12 See [Haven Facility Operations — Source Coverage and Open Decisions](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-source-coverage-and-open-decisions-0bf9ab4bebce).

**Build contract:** [Haven Facility Operations — Build Scope](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-build-scope-fa76df5ada21). **Sequence:** [Haven Facility Operations — Delivery Roadmap](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-delivery-roadmap-eab29aa94849).

One bounded implementation segment at a time. Record exact source/commit, focused behavioral tests, applicable repository segment gates, review and rollback/handoff evidence. Preserve current authority after waits and on retries, existing dirty/concurrent work, source truth and unknown rules. No new dependency, external transmission, clinical/employment decision or policy activation is implied. Keep source/local/hosted/provider/staff/operating-cycle acceptance distinct. No named assignee, estimate or date has been invented.

Roadmap key: HFO-16 / HAVEN-ADMIN-20260909
